messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table (Japanese translation)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (to English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------|--------| | In | preposition “in” (introduces the domain “all parts”) | で (as part of **領域で**) | “in” (locative) | OK | | tutte | adjective “all” (quantifier) | すべての | “all” | OK | | parti | noun “parts” (the set of regions) | 領域 | “regions / parts” | OK | | impera | verb “governs” (exerts rule) | 支配し | “governs” (conjunctive) | OK | | e | conjunction “and” (coordinates two predicates) | し (conjunctive) | “and” (as connective) | OK | | quivi | adverb “there” (place of reign) | そこでも | “there also” | OK | | regge | verb “reigns” (holds sovereign authority) | 統治する | “reigns” | OK | | quivi | adverb “there” (place of city & seat) | そこは | “there is” | OK | | è | copular verb “is” (asserts existence) | である | “is” | OK | | la | definite article (feminine singular) | — (omitted) | *(none)* | **UNNECESSARY** | | sua | possessive adjective “his” (ownership) | 彼の | “his” | OK | | città | noun “city” (urban domain) | 都市 | “city” | OK | | e | conjunction “and” (coordinates “city” and “seat”) | であり | “and” (copular conjunction) | OK | | l'alto | adjective “lofty” (qualifies seat) | 高き | “lofty” | OK | | seggio | noun “seat” (throne) | 座 | “seat” | OK | | oh | interjection “O” (vocative) | ああ | “oh” (exclamation) | OK | | felice | adjective “happy” (state of the chosen) | 幸せだ | “happy” | OK | | colui | pronoun “he / the one” (subject of election) | 者は | “the one (subject)” | OK | | cu' | relative pronoun “who/whom” (introduces relative clause) | — (omitted) | *(none)* | **UNNECESSARY** | | ivi | adverb “there” (location of election) | そこに | “there” (locative) | OK | | elegge | verb “elects” (chooses) | 選ばれた | “was chosen / elected” (passive) | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `la` (definite article) – Japanese does not use articles. - **UNNECESSARY**: `cu'` (relative pronoun) – the relative clause is expressed without an explicit pronoun in Japanese.
No source words are missing, incorrectly translated, or grammatically mismatched in the Japanese rendering.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 127** - Original: すべての領域で彼は支配しそこでも統治する; - Issue: none - Corrected: すべての領域で彼は支配しそこでも統治する;
- **Line 128** - Original: そこは彼の都市であり高き座である: - Issue: none - Corrected: そこは彼の都市であり高き座である:
- **Line 129** - Original: ああそこに選ばれた者は幸せだ！ - Issue: none - Corrected: ああそこに選ばれた者は幸せだ！
``` すべての領域で彼は支配しそこでも統治する; そこは彼の都市であり高き座である: ああそこに選ばれた者は幸せだ！ ```
